people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable

Powering Progress

### Optimal nutrition for all animals

Every day, we visit thousands of farms all over the world. De Heus specialists are 'hands on' – they
enjoy working closely with farmers, offering expert advice on nutritional strategies that meet
animals’ physiological needs as well as supporting farm management. Our goal is always the same: to
keep animals healthy and drive optimal production. It’s what we call **Powering Progress**!

## Supporting a diverse customer base

De Heus is a fully fledged supplier of nutritional products, producing compound feed, premixes,
concentrates and feed specialities for livestock and aquaculture customers worldwide.

[De-Heus-Myanmar-Animal-Feeds-Warehouse.jpg]

Our unique on the farm approach gives us valuable knowledge and insights to support thousands of
farmers all over the world.

# Our purpose

# Feeding the Future

Nutreco is a leading animal nutrition company offering solutions that go beyond nutrition – we
provide best-in-class advice and technology to help our customers produce more feed in a sustainable
way to feed the growing population.

## Nutreco's story 

Imagine a baby born in 2025. Digital native, world citizen, modern human. And like all the other 8,3
billion humans on the earth today (2026), an omnivore able to choose a varied diet, with protein an
important daily part. At Nutreco, our business is built around supporting the people who produce
this healthy protein.

[Read our story][56]

## Discover who we are in the video below

### Who we are
* ## Purpose, vision & values
  
  Everything we do as a company is driven by our purpose, vision and values.
  
  [ Read more ][57]
* ## Sustainability
  
  We are working across the value chain to create a more sustainable food system, and a better
  future for our industry and our planet.
  
  [ Read more ][58]
* ## People & careers
  
  We believe in three core elements to future success: strategy execution, innovation, and
  competence of our people. Our values; Trust, Inclusion,  Integrity, Curiosity and Passion are
  supportive of those three core elements. 
  
  [ Read more ][59]

# Feeding the Future

In a world with limited natural resources and a growing population, we want to use our scale and the
power of innovation to lead the change towards more circular and renewable food production methods,
with care and consideration for the people and nature that make them possible.

[Discover what drives us][65]

* [Our approach][66]
* [Our governance][67]
* [Our research][68]

## About Trouw Nutrition

We have a 90-year history of dedication to innovation and deep experience in developing smarter and
more sustainable ways of raising healthy farm animals and companion animals. Our broad portfolio of
feed specialties, feed additives, premixes and nutritional models and services, along with our
ever-increasing expertise in feed, farm and health make us a one-stop-shop with limitless
opportunities to create tailored, integrated solutions suited to each customer’s local situation.
And we are everywhere our customers need us, with a presence in 105 countries. We believe the power
of nutrition and good farm management can transform our industry – and even our planet. So, we are
challenging how the feed-to-food chain works today, to create a brighter future, from planet to
plate.

# Feeding the Future

In a world with limited natural resources and a growing population, we want to use our scale and the
power of innovation to lead the change towards more circular and renewable food production methods,
with care and consideration for the people and nature that make them possible.

[Discover what drives us][65]

* [Our approach][66]
* [Our governance][67]
* [Our research][68]

## About Trouw Nutrition

We have a 90-year history of dedication to innovation and deep experience in developing smarter and
more sustainable ways of raising healthy farm animals and companion animals. Our broad portfolio of
feed specialties, feed additives, premixes and nutritional models and services, along with our
ever-increasing expertise in feed, farm and health make us a one-stop-shop with limitless
opportunities to create tailored, integrated solutions suited to each customer’s local situation.
And we are everywhere our customers need us, with a presence in 105 countries. We believe the power
of nutrition and good farm management can transform our industry – and even our planet. So, we are
challenging how the feed-to-food chain works today, to create a brighter future, from planet to
plate.

# Nourish your advantage

Nutrition you can trust, support you can count on and partnerships that help your animals thrive

[Learn More][11]

We are Akralos.

Akralos is the corporate home of trusted animal nutrition brands, including **Hubbard** in the U.S.
and **Masterfeeds** in Canada, formed as a joint venture between global leaders Alltech and ADM.
Through our industry-leading brands, we deliver high-quality feed and nutritional solutions for
livestock, equine, backyard and leisure animals. We combine Alltech’s innovation-led,
customer-focused approach with ADM’s operational scale and nutritional expertise to deliver
consistent, high-performance animal nutrition, practical guidance and partnerships that give our
customers a competitive edge.

Built on generations of expertise, designed for what’s next

Animal nutrition is evolving. Staying ahead requires access to innovation, expertise and science.
Our team brings deep scientific knowledge, industry experience and a genuine commitment to provide
proven solutions, personalized service and high-quality feeds that strengthen animal performance and
producers’ long-term profitability.

What we deliverYour edge in animal nutritionAkralos operates an extensive network of feed mills
across the United States and Canada. We offer a comprehensive portfolio of industry-leading feeds,
minerals and supplements that support animal health, performance and quality of life. Powered by
leading-edge technology and R&D, broad logistical infrastructure and deep connections across the
agri-food value chain, Akralos is committed to delivering innovative solutions and trusted
partnerships that help customers nourish their advantage — every day, through the brands and local
teams they rely on.
[Learn More][12]

Industry-leading animal nutrition brands

Through our trusted brands, Akralos delivers reliable, high-quality feeds, minerals and supplements
for livestock, equine, backyard and leisure animals. Supported by a network of more than 40 feed
mills across the United States and Canada, our brands offer a comprehensive portfolio of proven
animal nutrition solutions, along with practical guidance and personalized service from experienced
teams our customers know and trust.
[

Hubbard brands — including Blueprint® minerals, Crystalyx® low-moisture blocks, Powerstart® gut
health solutions, and ShowTec® and Show-Rite® feeds for livestock in competition — deliver
practical, research-backed nutrition solutions and services that help customers improve productivity
and gain a competitive edge.

View
][13]
[

Since 1929, the Masterfeeds team has proudly served agri-food producers across Canada with complete
feeds, premixes and supplements. Our brands include including ShowStopper™, Rite-Lix®, Rough ‘n’
Ready, Bos Builder™, Vigor, Robo-Max, Power Calf, Power Track, Farm Choice™ Feeds and more.

View
][14]
[

McCauley's science-based equine nutrition solutions nourish horses of all ages and activity levels,
from racing champions to family companions. And, since safety is a top priority at McCauley’s, its
feeds are produced in an equine-only, drug- and ionophore-free feed mill.

View
][15]

> “Our vision is to become the most trusted name in animal nutrition by delivering high-performance
> feeds and partnerships that drive results. We’re here to listen, collaborate and use science to
> solve real-world challenges — nourishing advantage for all of our customers and partners.”
> 
> **Brian Gier**Chief Executive Officer

## Grow your career with us

Join our team in delivering better nutrition that strengthens animal health, supports livelihoods
and helps communities flourish.

# **О заводе «Алель Корм»**

**Жамбылский комбикормовый завод (филиал АО «Алель Агро») — это высокотехнологичное предприятие
нового поколения, запущенное в ноябре 2022 года. Мы создаем фундамент для эффективного
животноводства, производя безопасные и экологически чистые корма по мировым стандартам.

Технологии и Качество
Наш завод оснащен оборудованием лидера отрасли, и управляется интеллектуальной системой.

Максимальная автоматизация: Весь производственный процесс — от очистки сырья до напыления
аминокислот — контролируется программным обеспечением.

Безопасность (Халал): Вертикальная схема завода исключает смешивание разных видов кормов. Мы
используем только растительное сырье (пшеница, ячмень, кукуруза), что подтверждается сертификатом
«Халал».

Мировые партнеры: Для обогащения кормов мы закупаем добавки только у признанных мировых лидеров.

Наша продукция
Мы специализируемся на производстве специализированных комбикормов для:****
Бройлеров (полный цикл: Предстарт, Старт, Рост, Финиш).
Крупного рогатого скота (КРС).
Лошадей.
Мелкого рогатого скота (МРС).

Инфраструктура и Логистика
Завод представляет собой полноценный индустриальный комплекс в ауле Ушбулак, включающий:

-Современный силосный корпус (15 силосов) с системами термометрии.
-Собственные железнодорожные и автомобильные пункты приема сырья.
-Лабораторию для забора проб и проверки качества на любой стадии.
-Условия отгрузки: Мы ценим время наших партнеров, поэтому вся отгрузка готовой продукции
осуществляется оперативно.**
**

# **О заводе «Алель Корм»**

**Жамбылский комбикормовый завод (филиал АО «Алель Агро») — это высокотехнологичное предприятие
нового поколения, запущенное в ноябре 2022 года. Мы создаем фундамент для эффективного
животноводства, производя безопасные и экологически чистые корма по мировым стандартам.

Технологии и Качество
Наш завод оснащен оборудованием лидера отрасли, и управляется интеллектуальной системой.

Максимальная автоматизация: Весь производственный процесс — от очистки сырья до напыления
аминокислот — контролируется программным обеспечением.

Безопасность (Халал): Вертикальная схема завода исключает смешивание разных видов кормов. Мы
используем только растительное сырье (пшеница, ячмень, кукуруза), что подтверждается сертификатом
«Халал».

Мировые партнеры: Для обогащения кормов мы закупаем добавки только у признанных мировых лидеров.

Наша продукция
Мы специализируемся на производстве специализированных комбикормов для:****
Бройлеров (полный цикл: Предстарт, Старт, Рост, Финиш).
Крупного рогатого скота (КРС).
Лошадей.
Мелкого рогатого скота (МРС).

Инфраструктура и Логистика
Завод представляет собой полноценный индустриальный комплекс в ауле Ушбулак, включающий:

-Современный силосный корпус (15 силосов) с системами термометрии.
-Собственные железнодорожные и автомобильные пункты приема сырья.
-Лабораторию для забора проб и проверки качества на любой стадии.
-Условия отгрузки: Мы ценим время наших партнеров, поэтому вся отгрузка готовой продукции
осуществляется оперативно.**

We are known on the market as a reliable business partner that focuses on the best interests of both
suppliers and clients.

Since 1997, Cagemax has been trading high-quality animal proteins and fats. We have successfully

For hot temperatures
Available in high-temperature steels (for applications up to +1000 degrees Celsius)
Gear

Established in 1996, CFE Group is a market leader in Ireland and the UK of pelleting consumables and
has a reputation of supplying innovative and leading industry products and services. CFE Group have
a diverse range of clients from large multi-national companies to small regional family-owned
businesses across a range of industries and sectors including animal feed milling, wood pelleting,
fertiliser pelleting, grass and straw pelleting.

### **CFE Group are official agents for CPM**

****

## Cost Per Tonne

Innovative concept to benchmark consumable costs against production creating clarity on production
costs per tonne.

[Find Out More][38]

## Services

A wide range of support services are offered to optimise pelleting equipment performance and support
on site.

[Find Out More][39]

## New Equipment

Comprehensive equipment for grinding, pelleting, cooling, sifting that ensures continuous operation
and high performance.

[Find Out More][40]

## Partners

CFE Group work with many partners to offer the latest products and services supported with
innovative new technologies.

[Find Out More][41]

## Refurbished Equipment

Fully refurbished pelleting equipment including pellet presses, grinders, coolers, conditioner,
grinders.

[Find Out More][42]

## News

Keep up to date with the latest news, events and projects that the CFE Group are involved with
across the UK and Ireland.

[Latest News][43]

## Testimonials from our clients

CFE Group work with a wide range of manufacturers of feed and renewable energy products across the
UK, Ireland and Europe. Our products and services provide clients with the total solution for
pelleting consumables

“Thank you again for CFE’s hard work. It’s great to have peace of mind that work was carried out to
a high standard. Just wanted to let you know the start-up went well, we were back in production as
planned. I hope to see you return next year.”

**Sean Lacken, Pellet Plant Production Engineer, Balcas**

*“In order to keep up with the demand for feed from our ever increasing customer base , Bretts have
invested in a new pelleting and conditioning line , installing a CPM 7932-11 with lineator and RSM
along with a llx model for double conditioning and all controlled using the most up to date
technology and software. This strategic investment has allowed us to double capacity while enhancing
pellet quality enabling Bretts to service all our farm customers into the future.”*

**Liam Brett, Brett Brothers Limited**

*“We have been working with CPM now for over a decade. We find their presses to be very well
designed, well-engineered and very robust. Our experience shows that CPM presses can be relied on to
produce good **quality pellets at high throughput rates and efficient energy consumption. Our
operator’s find them easy to work with and CFE provide excellent after sales support regarding spare
parts availability and servicing. Actually, we’ve just installed another CPM 7931-11 press last
year.”*

**Eugene Woodbyrne, Enterprise Manager, Glanbia Agribusiness**

*“CFE are key Partners with Dairygold since 1996 and their Pelleting Consumable Contract model is
financially competitive and has enabled Dairygold Quality Feeds to budget costs, benchmark
performance and achieve production efficiencies at their Lombardstown Mill”*

**Tony Mannix, Milling & Grain Operations Manager, Dairygold**

## Meet The CFE Group Team

CFE Group employs over 40 team members across our two sites. The business is focused on people to
ensure our clients receive the best support and service for our industry-leading products.

## About CLFMA of India

### CLFMA is recognized by Central and State Governments, Livestock Farmers and Related Stakeholders

CLFMA was formed in June 1967 as The Compound Feed Manufacturers Association, CLFMA now has around
250+ members, including all sectors of the livestock industry. CLFMA OF INDIA is recognized not only
by livestock farmers, Central and State Governments, Government Departments, Agricultural
Universities, Veterinary Colleges and National Research Institutes in the country, but also by
related sectors outside the country.

CLFMA of India is the apex organization and the voice of the country’s dynamic livestock sector. It
currently has over 230 members representing diverse sub-sectors of animal protein value chain
including feed manufacturing, poultry, dairy and aquaculture business, animal nutrition and health,
veterinary services, machinery and equipment, processing, distribution and retailing of meat, and
ancillary services such as banking.

## About CLFMA of India

### CLFMA is recognized by Central and State Governments, Livestock Farmers and Related Stakeholders

CLFMA was formed in June 1967 as The Compound Feed Manufacturers Association, CLFMA now has around
250+ members, including all sectors of the livestock industry. CLFMA OF INDIA is recognized not only
by livestock farmers, Central and State Governments, Government Departments, Agricultural
Universities, Veterinary Colleges and National Research Institutes in the country, but also by
related sectors outside the country.

CLFMA of India is the apex organization and the voice of the country’s dynamic livestock sector. It
currently has over 230 members representing diverse sub-sectors of animal protein value chain
including feed manufacturing, poultry, dairy and aquaculture business, animal nutrition and health,
veterinary services, machinery and equipment, processing, distribution and retailing of meat, and
ancillary services such as banking.

# Delivering Excellency in Livestock Fodder

Drupada Mitra Taksaka is a trusted livestock feed distributor in Indonesia, supplying high-quality
feed ingredients such as cassava chips, molasses, palm kernel meal, copra meal, CGF, and industrial
salt to support sustainable livestock nutrition.

[white cement bags stacked in piles]

##### Who Are We?

## Your Strategic Partner in Livestock Nutrition

Drupada Mitra Taksaka is a dedicated distributor of essential feed ingredients. Our extensive
portfolio includes minerals and agricultural by-products sourced with strict quality control to
ensure optimal livestock health and performance.

 

We’re committed to helping our clients grow sustainably through dependable supply chains and
responsive service.

[ Know More About Us ][12]

## Our Product

[Gaplek]

#### Dried Cassava

A reliable carbohydrate source used in livestock feed formulations. Our dried cassava is processed
to ensure low moisture and high nutritional value, ideal for ruminants and poultry feed.

#### Palm Kernel Meal

A high-fiber, protein-rich by-product of palm oil extraction. Palm Kernel Meal is a cost-effective
feed ingredient widely used for cattle, goats, and sheep to support growth and energy needs.

#### Salt

An essential mineral additive in feed rations that promotes digestion, enhances appetite, and
supports overall animal health. We supply industrial-grade salt suitable for livestock and feed
processing.

## Advancing Animal Nutrition with Science‑Backed Solutions

At DSAND Animal Nutrition, we develop innovative feed additives that help farmers, integrators, and
nutritionists achieve healthier, more productive animals across poultry, dairy, swine, aquaculture,
and pets. Our portfolio includes enzymes, probiotics, organic acids, pellet binders, phytochemicals,
and functional premixes—all designed to improve feed efficiency, support gut health, and maximize
return on investment. Backed by cutting‑edge R&D, certified manufacturing, and proven field trials,
DSAND delivers measurable results with every product.

## DSAND difference at a glance
* **Boost growth and performance** with precision enzyme and protease solutions.

##### Welcome to the Wageningen University and Research eDepot

This is the Wageningen University and Research eDepot. In this repository we store files for
[Research@WUR][5] (our Current Research Information System), several Documentation databases and
[WUR Library Search][6] (our catalogue). You cannot search this eDepot itself.

Check the [WUR Library website][7] for a complete overview of our services.

Do you want to know more about our eDepot, please contact [servicedesk.facilities@wur.nl][8]

If you are interested in indexing our eDepot items there is a [sitemap][9] available

## products][199]

Over 100 cases have been reported across Europe, mainly affecting children and young adults, with
evidence linking the outbreak to flavoured noodle products.

## [EFSA lowers safe level for exposure to TFA ][200]

The European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) has reduced the safe level of trifluoroacetic acid (TFA)
in the diet based on new scientific evidence. TFA is a breakdown product of some pesticides.

Italy, confirming that research on one of the world's most damaging plant pathogens has reached a
new level of maturity.

# The Perfect Balance in Animal Feed

Farmers have been enjoying the perfect balance in animal nutrition with Epol since 1916, because
we’re obsessed with understanding and servicing the needs of our customers and their animals.

[About Epol][116]

## epol products

We offer animal feeds across most species either in bulk or in bags directly to farmers as well as
in bags through a wide network of partner resellers.

Feeds are supplied from 6 mills located across South Africa.

Regional demand determines local product availability to ensure our offer is relevant for the market
it serves, so if you are unable to find a product you are looking for, please contact us and we will
see how we can assist. (info@epol.co.za)

In addition to the feeds listed here we deliver unique custom mixes to suit individual needs where
our standard ranges do not satisfy your requirements, although minimum order quantities will apply.
[Contact your nearest TA][117] or email us on [info@epol.co.za][118] for more information.

# The Perfect Balance in Animal Feed

Farmers have been enjoying the perfect balance in animal nutrition with Epol since 1916, because
we’re obsessed with understanding and servicing the needs of our customers and their animals.

[About Epol][116]

## epol products

We offer animal feeds across most species either in bulk or in bags directly to farmers as well as
in bags through a wide network of partner resellers.

Feeds are supplied from 6 mills located across South Africa.

Regional demand determines local product availability to ensure our offer is relevant for the market
it serves, so if you are unable to find a product you are looking for, please contact us and we will
see how we can assist. (info@epol.co.za)

In addition to the feeds listed here we deliver unique custom mixes to suit individual needs where
our standard ranges do not satisfy your requirements, although minimum order quantities will apply.
[Contact your nearest TA][117] or email us on [info@epol.co.za][118] for more information.

## EU Vulnerability
## for Access to Essential Nutritional Feed Additives – FEFAC diagnosis and
## recommendations for mitigation measures

With the support of its members, FEFAC issued in September 2025 a study on EU vulnerability
regarding access to essential nutritional feed additives. On this basis,** **the European Commission
and the EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy underlined in their [Joint
Communication on Strengthening EU Economic Security][64] in December 2025, the** **strategic
dependency on third countries faced by the EU for the sourcing of feed and feed additives. In March
2026, FEFAC provided its recommendations on measures and tools to mitigate the impact of this
dependency.

**[READ MORE>][65]**

## EU Feed Circularity Catalogue – Existing Legal Restrictions to Enhanced Animal Feed Circularity

FEFAC, together with seven other industry sector federations and stakeholder organisations, launched
a joint initiative to raise awareness on the regulatory obstacles currently limiting feed
circularity in livestock production. The objective is to promote the development of a supportive
legislative environment that encourages greater circularity in feed ingredient sourcing, without
compromising safety. A set of proposed measures has been detailed in a joint report, alongside
practical examples of regulatory restrictions that deserve re-examination. This initiative could
serve as a foundation for an EU Feed Circularity Roadmap and feed into ongoing policy discussions,
including the EU Circular Economy Act and upcoming reviews of relevant EU regulations.

**[READ MORE>][66]**

## Sustainable Animal Feeding Strategies

FEFAC initiated an awareness campaign on the potential benefits of advanced feeding strategies for
enhanced and circular sustainable livestock and aquaculture production. The objective is to
facilitate access to chain partners and decision-makers to sound scientific-based information on the
techniques themselves, how they work and for which species, but also some considerations on the
economic impacts and trade-offs. Practical case studies showcasing existing animal feeding
strategies are now available online on the FEFAC website.

**[CASE STUDIES>][67]**

## FEFAC Feed Sustainability Charter 2030

In September 2020 FEFAC launched its Feed Sustainability Charter 2030, setting out the five
ambitions that contribute to more sustainable feed production. In October 2025 FEFAC released its
5th Feed Sustainability Charter Progress Report.

## EU Vulnerability
## for Access to Essential Nutritional Feed Additives – FEFAC diagnosis and
## recommendations for mitigation measures

With the support of its members, FEFAC issued in September 2025 a study on EU vulnerability
regarding access to essential nutritional feed additives. On this basis,** **the European Commission
and the EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy underlined in their [Joint
Communication on Strengthening EU Economic Security][64] in December 2025, the** **strategic
dependency on third countries faced by the EU for the sourcing of feed and feed additives. In March
2026, FEFAC provided its recommendations on measures and tools to mitigate the impact of this
dependency.

**[READ MORE>][65]**

## EU Feed Circularity Catalogue – Existing Legal Restrictions to Enhanced Animal Feed Circularity

FEFAC, together with seven other industry sector federations and stakeholder organisations, launched
a joint initiative to raise awareness on the regulatory obstacles currently limiting feed
circularity in livestock production. The objective is to promote the development of a supportive
legislative environment that encourages greater circularity in feed ingredient sourcing, without
compromising safety. A set of proposed measures has been detailed in a joint report, alongside
practical examples of regulatory restrictions that deserve re-examination. This initiative could
serve as a foundation for an EU Feed Circularity Roadmap and feed into ongoing policy discussions,
including the EU Circular Economy Act and upcoming reviews of relevant EU regulations.

FEFAC initiated an awareness campaign on the potential benefits of advanced feeding strategies for
enhanced and circular sustainable livestock and aquaculture production. The objective is to
facilitate access to chain partners and decision-makers to sound scientific-based information on the
techniques themselves, how they work and for which species, but also some considerations on the
economic impacts and trade-offs. Practical case studies showcasing existing animal feeding
strategies are now available online on the FEFAC website.

# Global smart farm assurance solutions

We offer a portfolio of robust, streamlined, and easy-to-use solutions for the certification of
agriculture, aquaculture, and floriculture production processes. With our standards, delivery
services, and capacity building program, we foster the global adoption of safer and more responsible
farming practices in more than 130 countries worldwide.

## What we do

We set standards for primary production and the supply chain. From fruits and flowers to fish and
feed, our portfolio is based on a robust third-party certification system that is developed in
collaboration with sector stakeholders and strengthened by an innovative IT platform. Our holistic
solutions and broader activities support the six key impact areas of food safety, environment,
workers’ health, safety, and welfare, animal welfare, supply chain transparency, and capacity
building.

#### The best connection to agriculture

HaBeMa Futtermittel GmbH & Co. KG has established itself in a short time as one of the most
efficient service companies on the German feed market since its foundation in 1994. The exposed
location in the port of Hamburg, one of the most important hubs for worldwide imports and exports,
makes HaBeMa an important, supra-regional trading partner for feed, compound feed and grain.

## HaBeMa's core business in Hamburg

Compound feed production

The direct link to the seaward port with all the possibilities for sourcing feedstuffs was a
decisive factor in the choice of this unique location before the foundation stone was laid for the
plant in 1970. In a compound feed plant that has been modernized time and again, high-quality feeds
for all farm animals are still produced today. The use of state-of-the-art technology meets the
highest standards for quality and safety in animal nutrition.

[Compound feed production][12]
Raw materials handling

Efficient handling facilities and large storage capacities offer all possibilities from the import
of various feedstuffs to the export of grain.

[Raw materials handling][13]
Logistics

Permanent provision of raw materials and compound feeds and a 24-hour distribution service with
HaBeMa's own fleet of vehicles round off the range of services.

[Logistics][14]

## This is HaBeMa

## Our premises

## Branch offices

With the geopolitical changes in Europe, business relations with Eastern Europe were also expanded
in the agricultural sector. Not only surpluses of grain and other feed materials in Eastern European
countries, but also the politically intended reduction of transatlantic imports were and are strong
arguments for these trade relations. However, the logistical challenge should not be underestimated!
In parts, an inadequate infrastructure, rising energy costs and, last but not least, the
introduction of toll charges call for new concepts to overcome greater distances.

With the AGRO terminal in Heidenau [www.agro-terminal.com][15] near the Czech border, HaBeMa has a
strategically extremely well located transshipment terminal. Thanks to the direct rail link on the
Prague-Dresden-Hamburg long-distance rail route, feed and grain can be shipped among each other by
self-propelled trains to create an optimal supply for the region's agricultural trade.

With the AGRO terminal in Drentwede [www.agro-terminal.com][16] directly at the gates of the
Vechta-Cloppenburg finishing stronghold, a further transshipment point based on the Heidenau model
is to ensure that the compound feed producers in this region are supplied with a large range of
straight feedstuffs in the desired quality.

#### The best connection to agriculture

HaBeMa Futtermittel GmbH & Co. KG has established itself in a short time as one of the most
efficient service companies on the German feed market since its foundation in 1994. The exposed
location in the port of Hamburg, one of the most important hubs for worldwide imports and exports,
makes HaBeMa an important, supra-regional trading partner for feed, compound feed and grain.

## HaBeMa's core business in Hamburg

Compound feed production

The direct link to the seaward port with all the possibilities for sourcing feedstuffs was a
decisive factor in the choice of this unique location before the foundation stone was laid for the
plant in 1970. In a compound feed plant that has been modernized time and again, high-quality feeds
for all farm animals are still produced today. The use of state-of-the-art technology meets the
highest standards for quality and safety in animal nutrition.

[Compound feed production][12]
Raw materials handling

Efficient handling facilities and large storage capacities offer all possibilities from the import
of various feedstuffs to the export of grain.

[Raw materials handling][13]
Logistics

Permanent provision of raw materials and compound feeds and a 24-hour distribution service with
HaBeMa's own fleet of vehicles round off the range of services.

[Logistics][14]

# Stay true.
# **Go far.**

## Since 1886, we’ve built connections between commodity supply and demand. But our greatest legacy
## is the trust we build with our customers every day.

For five generations, we’ve weathered every major shift in agribusiness. As the ag industry
continues to evolve, our commitment to staying flexible and working safely remains steadfast.

 

Honest relationships are the foundation of our business, so we do what it takes to get the job done
right.

Expertise in commodities and feed manufacturing helps us solve problems with confidence and speed.

Regional autonomy supported by private, family ownership puts more control at the local level to
serve you better.

[Who We Are][28]

[Aerial of Gooding Mill catwalk at sunset]

## In between supply and demand, you’ll find an expert from JDH.

#### Products

### Grains, co-products and animal feed delivered as promised.

We offer reliable and consistent access to all the commodities and feed solutions you depend on
year-round.
* Deep product knowledge
* Proactive communication
* Consultative partnership

[See all products][29]

#### Markets we serve

### Food and beverage manufacturers, bio-fuel producers, mills, dairies, aquaculture and so much
### more.

We put our market knowledge to work for your business so you always have the solutions you need.
* Localized decision-making
* Dedicated, professional support
* End-to-end logistics

[See all Markets][30]

#### Geographies we serve

### Logistical excellence for destination markets.

We have a dynamic network of transportation connections to deliver your products on time, as
promised.
* Extensive rail access
* Nimble problem solving
* Domestic and international solutions

[See all Locations][31]

## Our business is designed to make an impact.

We combine deep expertise in key agribusiness industries with executional expertise that keeps our
customers’ businesses moving.

### Regional expertise

**with access to 50 states, plus Canada, Mexico and Asia.**

### 22 million

**tons of product shipped by rail, truck or barge each year.**

### 575 employees

**based in key regions across the U.S. for grains, dairies, trading and milling.**

#### **JDH brands**

## Our integrated, wholly owned subsidiaries.

When it comes to meeting the needs of our customers, we do our best to deliver every time. Our
decentralized, subsidiary model empowers decision-making at the local level. Both JDH customers and
subsidiary customers get the support they need from people they know and trust.

[Our brands][32]

[

Commodity trading and dairy feed solutions in the northeastern U.S.

][33] [

Bringing feed ingredients and grain by-products to markets across the U.S. and Canada.

][34] [

Marketing for ethanol production co-products and container export for a wide range of commodities.

][35]

##### Our people

## Stability, community and safety.

At JDH, we take care of our employees so they can take care of their families. Our culture is rooted
in autonomy and respect so everyone has the opportunity to grow and reach their potential.

> I’ve appreciated the integrity, honesty and family values of this company for 15 years.

Senior Merchandising Assistant Supervisor, Amarillo, Texas

# Stay true.
# **Go far.**

## Since 1886, we’ve built connections between commodity supply and demand. But our greatest legacy
## is the trust we build with our customers every day.

For five generations, we’ve weathered every major shift in agribusiness. As the ag industry
continues to evolve, our commitment to staying flexible and working safely remains steadfast.

 

Honest relationships are the foundation of our business, so we do what it takes to get the job done
right.

Expertise in commodities and feed manufacturing helps us solve problems with confidence and speed.

Regional autonomy supported by private, family ownership puts more control at the local level to
serve you better.

[Who We Are][28]

[Aerial of Gooding Mill catwalk at sunset]

## In between supply and demand, you’ll find an expert from JDH.

#### Products

### Grains, co-products and animal feed delivered as promised.

We offer reliable and consistent access to all the commodities and feed solutions you depend on
year-round.
* Deep product knowledge
* Proactive communication
* Consultative partnership

[See all products][29]

#### Markets we serve

### Food and beverage manufacturers, bio-fuel producers, mills, dairies, aquaculture and so much
### more.

We put our market knowledge to work for your business so you always have the solutions you need.
* Localized decision-making
* Dedicated, professional support
* End-to-end logistics

[See all Markets][30]

#### Geographies we serve

### Logistical excellence for destination markets.

We have a dynamic network of transportation connections to deliver your products on time, as
promised.
* Extensive rail access
* Nimble problem solving
* Domestic and international solutions

[See all Locations][31]

## Our business is designed to make an impact.

We combine deep expertise in key agribusiness industries with executional expertise that keeps our
customers’ businesses moving.

### Regional expertise

**with access to 50 states, plus Canada, Mexico and Asia.**

### 22 million

**tons of product shipped by rail, truck or barge each year.**

### 575 employees

**based in key regions across the U.S. for grains, dairies, trading and milling.**

#### **JDH brands**

## Our integrated, wholly owned subsidiaries.

When it comes to meeting the needs of our customers, we do our best to deliver every time. Our
decentralized, subsidiary model empowers decision-making at the local level. Both JDH customers and
subsidiary customers get the support they need from people they know and trust.

[Our brands][32]

[

Commodity trading and dairy feed solutions in the northeastern U.S.

][33] [

Bringing feed ingredients and grain by-products to markets across the U.S. and Canada.

][34] [

Marketing for ethanol production co-products and container export for a wide range of commodities.

][35]

##### Our people

## Stability, community and safety.

At JDH, we take care of our employees so they can take care of their families. Our culture is rooted
in autonomy and respect so everyone has the opportunity to grow and reach their potential.

> I’ve appreciated the integrity, honesty and family values of this company for 15 years.

Senior Merchandising Assistant Supervisor, Amarillo, Texas

J&R Distributing, Inc., also known as J&R Feeds, is a South Dakota owned regional livestock feed
manufacturer. Located in Lake Norden, J&R sells swine, beef, dairy, poultry, and sheep feed.
Additionally, we carry pet foods and a full line of specialty feeds for game birds and exotic
animals. J&R Distributing, Inc. specializes in high quality, top-of-the-line nutrition products and
rations. We formulate for our clients on a complete feed basis to a premix basis. We sell complete
feeds, concentrates, base mixes, micro base mixes, and premix. We also handle a complete line of
feed ingredients. No livestock feeding program is complete without the technical assistance that
goes with it. On the nutrition side, we have in-house experts available to assist with ration
balancing and many other needs your livestock operation may require from ventilation to management
of the breeding herd. Our staff, in conjuction with the network of industry livestock experts, can
find an answer to almost any livestock problem. We provide on-site consultations; telephone
consultations; e-mail consultations; tissue/ serum sampling and interpretation; feed processing
management consultations.


With the many challenges in the livestock industry today, producers look to use a wide range of
ingredients for their livestock operation. J&R Distributing can help meet that need by providing
custom formulations to fit every need. We also bid customer formulations. If your livestock
operation is experiencing problems, we pride ourselves on formulations that eliminate problems with
the breeding herd, growth problems, cost problems, or just about any other problem that arises.
Customers can have their feed delivered right to the farm or mill by a professional team of delivery
personnel using up-to-date equipment. Our delivery fleet includes bag trucks, bulk trucks, bag/bulk
combination trucks, hopper bottom, and flatbeds. Customers can also pick up feed, both in bags or
bulk from our warehouse.

 

J&R Distributing also services clients through a dealer network throughout the greater South Dakota
region. J&R feed dealers are people experienced in the feed business who have availability to all
the services J&R Distributing has available. Dealers are an extension of J&R Distributing’s service
commitment to its customers. In addition to feed, J&R Distributing supplies all your animal health
needs, from vaccines to a full line of feed medications. We work closely with top veterinarians to
monitor closely what is new in animal health.

J&R Distributing, Inc., also known as J&R Feeds, is a South Dakota owned regional livestock feed
manufacturer. Located in Lake Norden, J&R sells swine, beef, dairy, poultry, and sheep feed.
Additionally, we carry pet foods and a full line of specialty feeds for game birds and exotic
animals. J&R Distributing, Inc. specializes in high quality, top-of-the-line nutrition products and
rations. We formulate for our clients on a complete feed basis to a premix basis. We sell complete
feeds, concentrates, base mixes, micro base mixes, and premix. We also handle a complete line of
feed ingredients. No livestock feeding program is complete without the technical assistance that
goes with it. On the nutrition side, we have in-house experts available to assist with ration
balancing and many other needs your livestock operation may require from ventilation to management
of the breeding herd. Our staff, in conjuction with the network of industry livestock experts, can
find an answer to almost any livestock problem. We provide on-site consultations; telephone
consultations; e-mail consultations; tissue/ serum sampling and interpretation; feed processing
management consultations.


With the many challenges in the livestock industry today, producers look to use a wide range of
ingredients for their livestock operation. J&R Distributing can help meet that need by providing
custom formulations to fit every need. We also bid customer formulations. If your livestock
operation is experiencing problems, we pride ourselves on formulations that eliminate problems with
the breeding herd, growth problems, cost problems, or just about any other problem that arises.
Customers can have their feed delivered right to the farm or mill by a professional team of delivery
personnel using up-to-date equipment. Our delivery fleet includes bag trucks, bulk trucks, bag/bulk
combination trucks, hopper bottom, and flatbeds. Customers can also pick up feed, both in bags or
bulk from our warehouse.

 

J&R Distributing also services clients through a dealer network throughout the greater South Dakota
region. J&R feed dealers are people experienced in the feed business who have availability to all
the services J&R Distributing has available. Dealers are an extension of J&R Distributing’s service
commitment to its customers. In addition to feed, J&R Distributing supplies all your animal health
needs, from vaccines to a full line of feed medications. We work closely with top veterinarians to
monitor closely what is new in animal health.

## What you get

🌐

### 11 regulatory standards

AAFCO (US 2013–2026), FEDIAF 2025, EU Reg 2020/354 PARNUT, eCFR 21 CFR, FDA GRAS, China GB/T + NY/T,
Korea Saeroo Gicho + NIAS 2024, Japan MAFF, Canada CFIA, NASC, PFI.

📚

### 1,620 RAG topics

Pre-generated, citation-rich blocks from compact 200-token briefs to full regulation extracts. Each
topic is grounded in source documents with a sources array in its meta.

⚖️

### Cross-standard compare

Diff 2–3 standards on the same nutrient / lifestage / basis query in one call via
`/api/v1/cross_compare`.

📦

### Batch nutrient queries

Up to 10 nutrients per request via `/api/v1/batch_nutrient` — agents don't need to loop single
queries.

🤖

### AI-crawler fast lane

24 recognized AI crawler user-agents (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, CCBot, and
more) get zero artificial delay and 60 req/min. Anonymous clients: 30 req/min with jittered delay.
No keys, ever.

🧾

### Machine-readable everything

OpenAPI schema at `/openapi.json`, crawler briefs at `/llm.txt` + `/llm-context.txt`, JSON-LD on
every page.

* **🇺🇸 United States — AAFCO · FDA · eCFR · USDA · NASC · PFI**219 topics

  labeling laws, approval labels.
* **🇪🇺 European Union — FEDIAF · EU Reg · EFSA · RASFF**239 topics

Coverage

## Topics by region
* **🇺🇸 United States — AAFCO · FDA · eCFR · USDA · NASC · PFI**219 topics
  AAFCO 2013–2026 nutrient profiles + Chapter 6 ingredient definitions, FDA GRAS/SCOGS/recalls + DCM
  investigation, eCFR 21 CFR Parts 501/573/582/589, USDA FoodData Central, NASC/PFI, US state feed &
  labeling laws, approval labels.
* **🇪🇺 European Union — FEDIAF · EU Reg · EFSA · RASFF**239 topics
  FEDIAF 2018–2025 + historical editions, EU PARNUT Reg 2020/354, Feed Catalogue Reg 68/2013, EFSA
  opinions, RASFF alerts, member-state ordinances, animal welfare/health.
* **🇨🇳 China — MOA · SAMR**145 topics
  GB/T 31216/31217, NY/T 4838/4839, MOA Pet Feed Regulation 2018, 农业农村部公告第20号,
  veterinary-drug regulations, recalls, dog-management rules, pet food standards.
* **🇰🇷 Korea — MAF · NIAS**101 topics
  Saeroo Gicho 2025 + Byeolpyo 15-2, NIAS 2024 nutrient tables, KSA pet food standards, vet-drug
  database, import rules, rabies, animal-protection law.
* **🇨🇦 Canada — CFIA · Health Canada**18 topics
  CFIA RG-1, VHH ingredient list, Feeds Regulations 2024, Health Canada permissible-claims tables.
* **🇯🇵 Japan — MAFF**43 topics
  Pet Food Safety Act 2008, MAFF Guidelines 2026, statutory contaminant/microbial limits,
  animal-welfare, pet food standards.
* **🌎 Other regions & global — Brazil · Mexico · Australia · intl + global evidence/ade/ingredient
  science**855 topics
  Brazil ANVISA RDC 26, Mexico SENASICA, Australia APVMA, intl/FAO/GAIN/USMCA — plus the global
  evidence layer (Europe PMC literature), openFDA adverse-event (ADE) reports, ingredient-nutrition
  science, and cross-jurisdiction law (banned breeds, toxicology, pet travel, vaccination statutes).

сельскохозяйственных животных, птиц и рыб. Мы предлагаем первоклассный комбикорм оптом от
производителя, созданный по рецептам концерна AGRAVIS Raiffeisen, с сертификатами качества и
гарантиями высокой эффективности.

Завод комбикормов производит рассыпные, структурированные корма, премиксы,
белково-витаминные-минеральные концентраты по оригинальным и классическим рецептам. В каталоге
официального сайта представлен широкий ассортимент продукции предприятия:
* Полнорационное питание для цыплят, бройлеров, кур-несушек, комбикорм для перепелов и индеек.
* Высококачественный комбикорм для свиней любого вида и возраста, корма для поросят и свиноматок.

  жизни, для молочных и стельных коров, а также для бычков на откорме, овец и коз.
* Корм для рыб, для роста и развития карповых в открытых водоемах и УЗВ.
* Полнорационный и концентрированный корм для кроликов: малышей, молодняка и взрослых особей мясных
  пород.

устройства с встроенными весами на 100 и 80 тонн, склады сырья и готовой продукции, лабораторный

поставляют напрямую из Германии.

developments across industries. The reports monitor pricing trends, trade activities, government
policies, regulatory updates, weather events, geopolitical developments, and other critical market

decisions.

across commodities and industries. Covering import-export trends, trading partners, trade policies,
tariffs, seasonal patterns, and market opportunities, these reports enable businesses to optimize
